baseline_models.focus_anchor: The second-person knowing verb governs the conceal/reveal pair, then the universal negation extends over any thing in earth or sky.
baseline_models.mechanism: Human agents divide matters into hidden and public states, while divine knowing crosses that division; the lower and upper realms then expand the same cancellation of concealment across the whole spatial field.

activation_trace.role: Direct apprehension by a knower supplies the governing epistemic relation.
Concealment supplies both the humanly produced hidden state and the state denied of anything before God.
Public manifestation supplies the visible pole paired with concealment.
The general knowable object makes the negation exhaustive rather than topic-limited.
The lower realm supplies one spatial extreme across which concealment fails.
What rises and covers supplies the upper spatial extreme completing the field.

changed_reading.before: God knows both private and public human matters.
changed_reading.after: The ayah twice cancels hiding: neither a human visibility choice nor placement anywhere in the lower-to-upper field can make even one knowable thing unavailable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The claim of complete knowledge is spoken as an address to 'our Lord' and includes what remains unexpressed as well as what is voiced.
baseline_models.mechanism: Lordship supplies ownership and sustaining completion, so knowledge is not presented only as detached observation; in this address it can support entrusting both unvoiced and voiced matters to the one who governs their completion.

activation_trace.role: Lordship and ownership establish the relational addressee of the knowledge claim.
Sustaining, repairing, and completing supply a care-bearing function for that lordship.
The split growth branch adds nourishment and development as an exploratory shade of sustaining care.
Unobstructed knowing makes both modes of the speaker's matter available to the addressee.
The concealed pole supplies needs or intentions not put into public form.
The public pole supplies what the speakers do put into manifest form.

changed_reading.before: The ayah asserts omniscience in the abstract.
changed_reading.after: Inside direct address, complete knowledge becomes a ground of trust: the sustaining Lord already holds what the speakers cannot or do not articulate as well as what they openly say.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first shows all parties coming into an exposed state before God, then repeats that exposure after earth and heavens are replaced. The focus ayah's present non-hiddenness therefore acquires a temporal counterpart: the realms that now fail to hide anything will themselves cease to function as stable cover when all becomes manifest.

activation_trace.role: Concealment supplies the focus state that is already ineffective before divine knowledge.
The lower realm supplies one apparent container whose hiding capacity is denied.
The upper covering realm supplies the other apparent container.
Coming visibly into the open converts epistemic non-hiddenness into enacted exposure before God.
One field standing in place of another makes earth and sky non-permanent containers.
Renewed open appearance after cosmic replacement completes the movement from known hiddenness to manifest presence.

structural_cues: 14:21 combines universal assembly with appearance before God.
14:48 replaces earth and heavens and immediately repeats appearance before God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present non-hiddenness, two scenes of open appearance, and cosmic replacement; I supply the temporal arrow from already known to eventually manifest. A live alternative is that omniscience and final exposure are parallel claims without a staged progression.

changed_reading.before: Nothing is presently outside divine awareness, wherever it is located.
changed_reading.after: Present divine knowledge anticipates a world in which hiding places and hidden postures lose even their phenomenal cover and all stands openly exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: A publicly intelligible word is compared with a tree whose fixed base and high branch connect earth to sky, while the corrupt counterpart is pulled out from the earth by its base. This turns the focus ayah's earth-sky span from a bare merism into a connected medium in which expressed words can root, rise, endure, or be uprooted.

activation_trace.role: Making something public anchors the model in the focus ayah's outward verbal and social pole.
The lower realm supplies the rooting end of the vertical field.
The upper realm supplies the branch's destination and the field's elevated end.
An intelligible expression supplies the utterance that enters the spatial-organic mechanism.
The stemmed tree supplies the living structure that joins lower base to upper growth.
The base supplies grounded origin and support for the expressed word.
A high offshoot rising from its base supplies upward consequence across the field.
Whole uprooting from the base supplies the failed inverse of stable verbal growth.

structural_cues: 14:24 orders expression, tree, fixed base, and skyward branch in one compact sequence.
14:26 contrasts an expression-tree removed from above the earth and left without stability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the word-tree comparison and its earth-to-sky geometry; I infer that the focus ayah's public-making can be read through that ecology. The live alternative is that the tree comparison concerns a distinct kind of word and does not characterize every act of proclamation.

changed_reading.before: Earth and sky simply mark the exhaustive range of what God knows.
changed_reading.after: The same range can also be heard as a vertical ecology of expression: what is made public may take root below, rise above, and bear durable consequences, or fail through uprooting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same secret/public polarity is attached earlier to one commanded act of expenditure. That direct parallel removes any automatic moral suspicion from concealment: secrecy and publicity can be two legitimate modes of practice, equally legible to God, rather than hidden guilt versus confessed virtue.

activation_trace.role: The focus concealment supplies the inward or non-public mode whose moral valence is revised.
The focus proclamation supplies the outward mode paired with concealment.
Material expenditure supplies one concrete practice carried out under both visibility modes.
Inward hiding supplies the explicitly legitimate secret mode of that practice.
Open manifestation supplies the matching public mode of the same practice.

structural_cues: 14:31 places secret and public adverbials side by side under one act of spending.
14:38 repeats the same polarity with first-person verbs of concealing and making public.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact visibility contrast attached to commanded spending; I infer that the focus's concealed category includes morally positive hidden action, not only withheld fault. The live alternative is that the focus remains maximally broad and carries no particular ethical valence.

changed_reading.before: What people conceal is liable to sound suspect, while what they proclaim sounds candid.
changed_reading.after: Hidden and public are morally non-identical only by content, not by visibility itself; both can be faithful modes of one act and both are already known.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated allotted provision is set inside a sky-to-earth chain of water and fruit and then becomes the request made for a barren valley. Joined to sustaining lordship in the focus, knowledge of everything in earth and sky can function as attentive governance of the whole provision system, including needs still concealed in the speaker.

activation_trace.role: Sustaining and completing supply the governing care that makes knowledge operational rather than merely observational.
Productive earth supplies the receiving and growing side of the provision field.
Sky as covering realm, cloud, and rain supplies the descending side of that field.
An allotted gift supplies the resource from which secret or public expenditure proceeds.
Allotted giving names the fruit produced through the sky-to-earth sequence.
The request for allotted giving brings the cosmic provision system into the speaker's immediate need.

structural_cues: 14:32 links heavens, earth, descending water, emerging fruit, and provision in causal order.
14:37 places a request for fruit-provision in a valley explicitly lacking cultivation immediately before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sustaining lordship, the sky-earth provision chain, and a local request for provision; I infer that complete knowledge coordinates care across that chain. A live alternative is that the focus asserts knowledge only, while provision remains a separate divine action.

changed_reading.before: The sustaining Lord knows hidden and public needs.
changed_reading.after: That knowledge can be read as providential attention spanning the complete route by which an unspoken need in a barren place is met through the earth-sky system.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human beings are unable to count and exhaustively encompass divine blessing just before the Abrahamic prayer begins, whereas the focus denies that even one thing escapes divine knowledge. The contrast sharpens the ayah into a confession of asymmetric cognition: human accounting fails inside a field fully known to God.

activation_trace.role: Complete apprehension supplies the divine side of the cognitive asymmetry.
The unrestricted knowable object makes the divine scope item-by-item exhaustive.
Counting discrete items supplies the human operation that proves inadequate.
Exhaustive numerical encompassing supplies the stronger limit explicitly denied to humans.

structural_cues: 14:34 states human failure to enumerate divine blessing.
14:35 begins the Abrahamic prayer sequence within which 14:38 asserts divine knowledge of every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent human failure of exhaustive counting and divine knowledge from which no thing is hidden; I treat their adjacency as a deliberate epistemic contrast. The live alternative is that the counting statement concerns gratitude rather than the focus's hidden/public distinction.

changed_reading.before: The ayah contrasts divine knowledge with human concealment.
changed_reading.after: It also contrasts divine comprehension with human incapacity to inventory even the gifts already received, making the prayer an act of epistemic dependence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus stands between detailed requests and praise of God as one who hears prayer, after which petition resumes. Its hidden/public pair therefore acts as a hinge: reception of prayer is not limited to audible formulation because divine knowing already encompasses the concealed intention from which the spoken call emerges.

activation_trace.role: Direct lordly address makes the knowledge statement part of an ongoing petition.
Apprehension independent of public visibility supplies access to the prayer's inward content.
Concealment supplies intention or need that has not entered audible form.
Manifest expression supplies the voiced petition.
Auditory reception supplies the explicit post-focus image of prayer being heard.
A verbal call supplies the outward form whose reception is affirmed.

structural_cues: 14:37 contains multiple requests and ends with an intended human response.
14:39 names the hearing of prayer, and 14:40 returns immediately to petition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a request-knowledge-hearing-request sequence; I infer that the middle claim warrants reception of both inward intention and voiced call. A live alternative is that 14:38 is an independent doxology with no mediating function.

changed_reading.before: God knows what the praying speakers keep private and what they say aloud.
changed_reading.after: The statement reassures the act of prayer itself: audible words are received, but the concealed need and intention preceding those words are already within divine apprehension.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's complete knowledge becomes the answer to a later mistaken inference: postponed consequence must not be calculated as divine inattention. Deliberate deeds remain known and move within an accounting frame even when judgment is not immediate.

activation_trace.role: Unobstructed knowing supplies the premise that blocks any inference of overlooked conduct.
The denial of successful hiding covers deeds whose consequence appears delayed.
Formal reckoning supplies the judicial frame immediately before the warning against misjudgment.
Human supposition supplies the erroneous conclusion drawn from delayed consequence.
Lapse that leaves something outside attention supplies the state explicitly denied of God.
Intentional action supplies the concrete object that remains under attention.
Final swift reckoning closes the accounting frame and distinguishes delay from omission.

structural_cues: 14:41 introduces the day on which accounting rises.
14:42 directly forbids construing God's relation to wrongful action as heedlessness and states postponement.
14:51 returns to rapid accounting for what each self acquired.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies complete knowledge, a denial of heedlessness toward intentional action, postponement, and final accounting; I infer that the focus preemptively corrects the delay-equals-neglect conclusion. The live alternative is that its immediate rhetorical work remains reassurance within prayer rather than warning to wrongdoers.

changed_reading.after: Non-visibility and non-immediacy are both denied evidentiary force: a concealed act and a delayed response are never grounds for calculating that the act was missed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus syntax uses the ordinary concealment sense, not an overt reversal. It remains anchored because the focus inventory explicitly preserves an uncovering branch for the same root and the early context supplies extraction from hiding plus disclosure by speech or sign. Downstream prose should present this only as a lexical counter-current shadowing concealment, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The same hiddenness root occurs in what 'we conceal' and in the denial that anything 'is hidden.'

activation_trace.role: The root's reversal branch supplies removal of hiddenness and makes the repeated concealment wording lexically unstable.
Extraction from concealment supplies an outward motion that activates the focus root's reversal branch.
Disclosure through speech or sign supplies a communicative form of bringing hidden content out.

changed_reading.before: Humans hide matters, but God sees through the concealment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the very wording of hiding carries a suppressed counter-motion toward extraction and disclosure, so concealment is lexically shadowed by its own undoing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the marker branch of knowing and a split mapped target under sky. It remains valid as an image because both are packet-provided focus branches and the context foregrounds visible signs. Downstream prose must describe a metaphor of legibility, not imply that divine knowledge depends on evidence or inference.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins knowing with an exhaustive earth-sky field.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing trace that guides recognition recasts knowing through an image of legibility.
The split target's visible identifying mark extends that legibility image into the upper field.
A manifest sign supplies the context activation for reading creation as marked and recognizable.

changed_reading.before: God directly knows every thing throughout earth and sky.
changed_reading.after: As a contained lexical image, earth and sky form a wholly legible field in which every thing bears or functions as a recognizable trace, leaving no genuinely unmarked remainder.

strongest_changes: The exact secret/public pairing in 14:31 revises concealment from presumptive guilt into a morally open mode that can include faithful hidden action.
The request-knowledge-hearing sequence in 14:37-40 makes the focus a warrant that prayer is received at the level of concealed intention as well as voiced call.
The open appearances in 14:21 and 14:48 turn timeless non-hiddenness into a trajectory toward manifest exposure.
The word-tree and provision sequences make earth and sky a connected field of verbal consequence and sustaining care, not only an exhaustive spatial merism.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is both a near-verbatim activation of the surah's secret/public practice and the epistemic hinge inside an extended prayer. Its earth-sky scope is repeatedly concretized by rooted speech, rain-fed provision, cosmic replacement, and final exposure.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the first-person plural remains limited to the praying household or is invited to widen through the surah's communal frames.
Whether earth and sky should remain primarily an exhaustive merism or also carry the activated vertical mechanisms of speech and provision.
How strongly the relational reassurance of sustaining knowledge and the judicial warning of inescapable accounting should be weighted against each other.
